The repository extracted the classifications, definitions, exclusions and explanatory notes from the spreadsheet tables and converted them to JSON. FoR and SEO division labels are shown in sentence case. FoR display translations were prepared independently by the repository. ToA has named categories. The repository assigned machine-readable IDs for storing them.
